description: Verify whether providers actually accept particular insurance and new patients.
notes: Inlined Kit fallback implements the full contract and is active by design; app runs standalone with zero console errors (Playwright-verified).

notes.note: Directories up to 40% stale is a real, enraging problem, and cross-checking four sources is the right approach. Weakest assumption: the data moat. This is a cold-start data aggregation business — you're competing with patient-report networks and the insurers' own (bad) data, and whoever has the freshest data wins. The product is the crawl, not the app.
Verify cross-checks 4 sources, conflict surfaced; copy summary OK, zero errors.
